question: After independence, the 1st national games were hosted by which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first National Games of India after independence were hosted in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. **
 
• **It Held in Lahore in 1924, and were previously known as the Indian Olympic Games​**
 
• The first National Games held on the lines of the Olympics took place in New Delhi in 1985.
 
• The **first National Games after independence symbolized the nation’s renewed focus on fostering sporting talent across the country.​​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**National Games in india:

 
• The duration and the regulations of the National Games are entirely within the jurisdiction of the Indian Olympic Association.
 
• The first three editions were all held in the city of Lahore.
 
• After the eighth edition in 1938 in Calcutta, the event was christened as the National Games.
 
• The city of Lucknow hosted the National Games in its first post-independence avatar.
 
• The 37th edition was held in Goa from 25 october to 9th november 2023.
 
 
• The official mascot for the 2023 National Games of India was Moga, an Indian bison.
 
• The motto of the 37th National Games was "Get Set Goa".
 
 

e1:T
